dsDescriptionValue.value: Chemotion-repository is a repository for the publication, re-use and archiving of research data in the domain of chemistry. It is suitable for molecules, reactions, and associated data. It stores original data in diverse file-formats including standard file types and as well as descriptions, metadata, and ontologies. The repository is open to all researchers worldwide.
